criteria: 能用斜率乘积判断垂直
set.description: For two lines with finite slopes, equal slopes mean parallel or coincident lines; strict parallelism also requires distinctness. The product of slopes is -1 exactly when those two nonvertical lines are perpendicular. Treat vertical and horizontal lines separately.
set.name: Using slopes to determine parallelism and perpendicularity
